full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic scene shows a young woman from behind facing her reflection in a narrow, dark-framed mirror. The setting is a dim interior of worn vertical panels, with a pale hanging fabric falling along the far left edge. A broad, weathered wooden upright separates that fabric from the mirror's dark opening. Inside the glass, her reflected face appears just left of center, looking outward with a steady, quiet expression. Her dark hair is gathered back from the forehead, and the soft line of a light collar surrounds her neck above a darker garment. One side of the reflected face is brighter, revealing the eyes, nose, and closed mouth, while the opposite side passes gradually into gray shadow. Behind the reflected head, the space is nearly black, with only an indistinct pale shape near the upper edge. In the foreground on the right, the actual woman turns her back to the camera; the rounded dark hair, exposed nape, pale collar, and dark vest-like upper garment are visible. Her near shoulder crosses in front of the mirror, hiding part of the reflected lower body and creating a close overlap of figure and image. The mirror's lower wooden rail is visible beneath the reflected chest, so the face seems held inside a narrow vertical compartment. Soft light from the left catches the pale fabric, the reflected face, and the foreground collar, while the wood and the garment remain in deeper tones. The photographic grain is fine, and the reflection has gently softened edges rather than a polished, glassy clarity. Broad black areas, mid-gray timber, and a few luminous skin and fabric surfaces create a calm tonal hierarchy. There is no readable text. The overall composition is intimate and still, balancing a near dark back against a softly illuminated face held inside the mirror.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影画面呈现一名背对镜头的年轻女子，面对狭窄深色边框镜中的自己。场景是由陈旧竖向板面围合的昏暗室内，最左缘垂下一幅浅色布料。一根宽阔而磨旧的木竖框把布料与镜中的暗色空间分开。玻璃里，她的倒影面孔出现在中央略左的位置，带着平静而安定的神情向外凝视。深发从额前向后拢起，浅色柔软衣领围着颈部，下面是较深的衣服。倒影脸的一侧较亮，显出眼睛、鼻子和闭合的嘴，另一侧则逐渐过渡到灰影。倒影头后方的空间近乎全黑，只有上缘附近一个模糊的浅色形状。右侧前景中，真实的女子背向镜头；可见圆润的深发、露出的后颈、浅色衣领和深色近似背心的上衣。近处肩膀横过镜前，挡住倒影下半身的一部分，使人物与镜像紧密重叠。镜子的下方木横框在倒影胸口下可见，因此面孔仿佛被收在一个狭窄的竖向隔间里。左侧的柔光照亮浅布、倒影的脸和前景衣领，木材与衣服则停留在更深的明度中。摄影颗粒细微，倒影边缘略微柔化，并不呈现光洁玻璃般的锐利。宽阔的黑色区域、中灰木材及少数明亮的肌肤和布料表面形成平静的明暗层级。画面没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而静止，以近处的深色背影平衡镜中柔和照亮的脸。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photographic style draws attention through close framing, quiet reflected light, and a restrained range from deep black to soft silver gray. A near form can overlap a more distant image, making depth emerge from partial concealment rather than a wide view. Weathered matte surfaces and fine film grain keep bright areas tactile, while dark areas remain broad and calm instead of filling with decorative detail. Vertical boundaries divide the frame into narrow zones, and a few pale curved shapes interrupt their straight rhythm. Soft side light gently models visible surfaces and falls away through gradual gray transitions, with the darkest recesses allowed to hold little information. Focus remains sufficiently clear at the central point of attention but loosens at surrounding edges. The composition is asymmetrical yet balanced by the weight of adjacent dark areas and a small luminous center. The overall effect is introspective, delicate, and observational, with mood carried by tonal restraint and layered framing.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色摄影风格以贴近的取景、安静的反射光，以及从深黑到柔银灰的克制层次吸引注意。近处形体可以遮住较远处影像的一部分，让纵深来自局部遮挡而非宽阔视野。磨旧的哑光表面与细微胶片颗粒使亮部保有触感，暗部则保持宽阔安静，不被装饰细节填满。竖向边界把画框分割为狭窄区域，少数浅色曲形打断其直线节奏。柔和侧光轻轻塑造可见表面，再经渐进的灰色过渡衰减，最深的凹处可以只保留极少信息。焦点在中央关注处足够清楚，在周围边缘逐渐松开。构图虽不对称，却由相邻深色区域的重量与小块明亮中心取得平衡。整体效果内省、细腻且富有观察感，气氛由克制的明暗与层叠的取景承载。
theme_en: A young woman meets her reflection in a narrow mirror
theme_zh: 年轻女子在狭窄镜中与自己的倒影相望
name: Edouard Boubat
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
